notes.title: Update notes for Jan 9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where achievements for long and full world leagues were not being awarded.
[*] Fixed a bug where, for some users, the game got stuck at the initial loading screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would win a world league but, if the final match was not a victory, then the opposing team would be shown cheering next to the podium.
[/list]

Thanks to all the players who reached out with feedback! You are really helpful.

notes.title: Update notes for Oct 20
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adjustments in court size for some street stages
[*] AI adjustments
[*] Physics tweaks to shots and passes
[*] Multiple non-critical bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for Sep 8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where difficulty was set to Hard automatically
[*] Shorter load times (initial and coming back from matches)
[*] AI adjustments made to [i]Easy[/i] and [i]Normal[/i] difficulties
[*] Fixed a bug with ingame texts that caused FPS to drop sporadically
[/list]

notes.title: Golazo 2 - Next festival Gameplay I
notes.content:
Livestream of the gameplay during the NEXT Steam Festival.
It will be the first time that we will show the game to the world after 2 years of hard work.
Don´t lose this opportunity to see all the game features:

- Street world tour
- Street gameplay and teams
- New and improved physics
- New 3D models
- 10 stadiums to play with
- 6 street locations
- 3 extra Leagues to show your talent

Echito our Lead game designer will be your host on this amazing stream!
